question: For the calendar year 2021, what is the overall average quantity sold of the top three best-selling hardware products (by total quantity sold) in each division?
sql:
SELECT 
    SUM(total_qty) as total_all_top3,
    COUNT(*) as num_products,
    AVG(total_qty) as overall_average
FROM (
    SELECT 
        p.division,
        p.product_code,
        SUM(s.sold_quantity) as total_qty,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.division ORDER BY SUM(s.sold_quantity) DESC) as rank_in_division
    FROM hardware_fact_sales_monthly s
    JOIN hardware_dim_product p ON s.product_code = p.product_code
    WHERE s.date LIKE '2021-%'
    GROUP BY p.division, p.product_code
    QUALIFY RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.division ORDER BY SUM(s.sold_quantity) DESC) <= 3
)
